section.title: omega probe
section.text:
RSI14: 14-period relative strength index (0–100). EMA5: 5-period exponential moving average. EMA5_EMA13_spread: % gap EMA5 vs EMA13. 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend = direction over the window. CCI: 20-period commodity channel index (±100 reference). 4-period trajectory (t3 → … → now); CCI_trend = direction over the window. VWAP: volume-weighted average price accumulated since the daily 00:00-UTC anchor. dist_VWAP: % from current price to VWAP. dist_VWAP_rank_hi: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one.

| coin | RSI14 | EMA5_EMA13_spread_t3 | EMA5_EMA13_spread_t2 | EMA5_EMA13_spread_t1 | EMA5_EMA13_spread_now | EMA5_EMA13_spread_trend | CCI_t3 | CCI_t2 | CCI_t1 | CCI_now | CCI_trend | dist_VWAP_rank_hi |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| BTC | 64.9 | 0.64 | 0.83 | 0.79 | 0.82 | rising | 195.9 | 238.0 | 183.5 | 183.5 | falling | 14/78 |
| GOOGL | 73.4 | 0.18 | 0.43 | 0.62 | 0.69 | rising | 133.7 | 260.8 | 247.8 | 247.8 | rising | 10/78 |

outputs.meaning: dist_VWAP: % from current price to VWAP. dist_VWAP_rank_hi: ordinal across the tracked universe, 1 = highest value, rendered as rank/universe-size; the standing as of the last close, unchanged until the next one.
share of the field’s directional picks that are up (%); absent when no bias has been measured
the direction the field leans, derived from the share; absent whenever the bias is, and at an exact 50/50 where no side dominates
share of captain picks landing on the single most-captained coin (%)
distinct coins picked, over distinct coins available
share of the scope's coins that closed up (%), over the universe it was measured across
share of the scope's coins that closed down (%), over the universe it was measured across
net breadth — the up share minus the down share (%), signed; negative is a broadly red field
mean close-change across the scope (%), signed
USDT/USD deviation from par (%), signed, from Coinbase’s USDT-USD spot tape quoted in USD; read as of its latest stored minute close and absent when that close is older than 15 minutes
USDC/USDT deviation from par (%), signed, from Binance’s USDCUSDT spot tape quoted in USDT; read as of its latest stored minute close and absent when that close is older than 15 minutes
